Avery / team — quick security triage below.

Summary: We can support a temporary (30-day) retention profile for pilot customers with constraints. Two implementation options:

1) Ephemeral retention profile (recommended): create an account-level policy that drops non-essential audit artifacts after 30 days while preserving minimal event indexes for troubleshooting. This requires a one-time config change and a short migration script (approx 4-5 engineer-days) to backfill active pointers. KMS/BYOK: compatible — logs remain encrypted with customer KMS, but key-rotation/escrow interactions need legal signoff.

2) Snapshot+escrow: take weekly sanitized snapshots that LogiCorp can retain off-platform for the pilot. Lower engineering effort, but shifts custody and increases procurement work.

SSO/SCIM mapping: audit entries already include federated_id when SCIM provisioning is used. We need to guarantee the mapping in our SOW and provide an export utility (CSV) that lists internal event_id -> federated_id for the pilot period. Minimal dev work (1-2 days) to expose the CSV via the console or a signed link.

Open risk: retention reductions increase support troubleshooting time and complicate post-mortem. Requesting legal to sign a Pilot Retention Exception Addendum (I can draft language).

Next steps I propose:
- Product + Infra estimate for option 1 (ephemeral profile) by EOD Jan 12
- Draft Pilot Retention Exception Addendum and send to LogiCorp legal
- Quick alignment call (30m) with LogiCorp + Product + Security — propose Jan 13 16:00 UTC

I will start a short RFC and add the infra owners.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: retention_proposal_v1.xlsx
